basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old gamer and music enthusiast living in the vibrant city of Chicago. When I'm not battling bots in TF2 or exploring community servers, you can find me attending local gigs in the Chicago music scene. I work as a graphic designer, which allows me to channel my creativity both in my job and my gaming hobbies. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility it gives me to dive deep into games and explore new music. My typical online hours are in the evening, usually post-10 PM, as that's when I wind down and get my game on.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of online multiplayer games, primarily from years of casual gaming and self-teaching. My knowledge of music comes from attending live performances and engaging with local music communities. I also stay updated with gaming news and trends through various forums and subreddits.
